Can you hea-WWwW|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 47 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Swordmaster''' was a major boss that only appeared as the third boss in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It was based on the [[Swordmaster]] from the [[SFOTH Event]]. This version, however, has over three times the base health of the [[Swordmaster]]. As with most major bosses, the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' has an extremely high amount of health. While the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' walks quite slowly, after it uses its ''Refusing Will'' move (a variant of Rage Mode that activates at half health), it will speed up in movement, making it very dangerous. While it cannot spawn any enemies of its own, its abilities can stun lots of towers in a short period of time. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Swordmaster''' has reflective black skin and glowing purple eyes. It has a dark red crown that is slightly tilted, a purple undershirt, and dark purple tattered pants and jacket. It wields two Darkheart swords that are held upside down. Being a major boss, it is significantly larger than the average enemy. ==Strategy== *Towers that deal high DPS, like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Turret]], [[Engineer]] and [[Accelerator]] can be useful to take down the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' quickly. **The [[Ranger]] can also be used, due to its high DPS and [[Stun Immunity]]. *Cheap towers can provide a distraction for the '''Fallen Swordmaster's''' ''Dagger Throw''. **This can be particularly useful as the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' stops moving to throw its swords. **However, do beware that the attack stuns towers around the target, meaning that poor placement can stun lots of towers at once. **If possible, try to spread out your towers. **In addition, after the '''Fallen Swordmaster's''' ''Refusing Will'' ability is activated, the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' can throw 4-5 swords at towers, instead of 3. **However, this wastes a tower slot in the late game which can be used to deal more damage. *Units can be quite useful against the '''Fallen Swordmaster''', as it has no attack that destroys units before they collide. **This makes the [[Engineer]]'s sentries very useful against the '''Fallen Swordmaster'''. **However, once the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' activates its ''Refusing Will'' ability, all units will phase through it, given that it temporarily gains [[Full Immunity]]. *The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability is recommended against the '''Fallen Swordmaster'''. **You can time the ability to avoid the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' from performing its ''Refusing Will'' move. If it has recently performed an ability, and you can kill the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' quickly from when it reaches 75,000 health, this move will not be performed. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also be used so that towers that are out of range of the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' can attack while being out of the range of some of the '''Fallen Swordmaster's''' attacks. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to shield towers from stuns performed by the '''Fallen Swordmaster'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenSwordmaster.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HardcoreThumbnail.jpg|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} VoidlandsDI2.png|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} HardcoreRender.png|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2020|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} Triumphantbadge2.png|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' on the Triumphant! [[Badges|badge]]. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexFallenSwordmaster.png|'''Fallen Swordmaster''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Fallen Swordmaster''' is the resurrected version of the original [[Swordmaster]], as stated by a [https://twitter.com/BelowNatural/status/1229276487607627776 tweet]. **It also suggests that other [[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]] enemies were meant to be brought back, however only the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' and [[Lava]] were brought back into the game. *The '''Fallen Swordmaster''' could be spawned before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] through commands. *Weirdly, the health of the '''Fallen Swordmaster''' was increased in [[MEGA Servers]], despite it not being able to spawn in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] without admin commands. *The '''Fallen Swordmaster''' can be seen as a chess piece in the [[Chess Board]] map, representing the Queen chess piece. *The [[Void Swordmaster]] is the successor to the [[Fallen Swordmaster]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 October 2020''' -
